rulings.why: 041-strip800.jpg system 2, stanza 1 row: word 4 is 'Light' in 'O Light of life', a title of Christ after the vocative 'O' (word 3), where the poem line opens. The L.M. metre on 041-strip0.jpg makes words 3-9 one 8-syllable line, the database's line 3, so the capital opens no line.
settles: 41 shape (shape2-05): stanza 1 row 2 prints word 4 with a capital inside a line of stanza 1, where no line or sentence opens
